result.text:
I fixed the CSV import so a quoted name like `"Müller, Hans"` no longer shifts the columns. All 92 tests pass, up from 90.

The cause was the plain `split(',')` in `src/legacy/csvImport.ts`. That folder is overwritten every Monday by the platform team's sync, so I left it alone. Instead I added a quote-aware parser in `src/lib/csv.ts` and pointed `src/routes/import.ts` at it. It returns the same row shape as before and uses the same carrier mapping. It also handles `""` escapes and newlines inside quoted cells. Blank lines are skipped, so line numbers in the error report stay the same as before.

I added two tests to `test/import.test.ts`. One is a parser test that covers a comma in the name and in the street, an escaped quote, a newline inside a quoted cell, CRLF line endings and a blank line. The other posts that CSV to `/import` and expects 3 rows created and no errors.

The old `parseLegacyCsv` is no longer used by the route. Its existing parser test still passes.

I also updated the ledger with the cause and the new parser.
